PRIVACY

Privacy Policy

Effective date: November 14, 2026 · Version 1.0 · Tomesi Garden, solitaire and puzzle games in a Japanese garden, for iPhone and iPad, and its presentation website.
Publisher: Olivier Saleur, sole proprietor (micro-entrepreneur) — 15 rue des Îles, 60340 Saint-Leu-d'Esserent, France — SIRET 106 671 837 00016.

Summary. The App does not collect, transmit or store any personal data. No account, no advertising, no analytics, no tracking. Your garden stays on your device and, if you are signed in to iCloud, in your own iCloud. In App Store terms: "Data Not Collected." Only the messages you choose to send to support are processed by us (see Article 11).

1. Who we are

The Tomesi Garden application (the "App") and this website are published by Olivier Saleur, sole proprietor (micro-entrepreneur), data controller within the meaning of the GDPR for the data described in Article 11 only. For any privacy question, contact us at support@tomesi.com or +33 9 72 16 41 97.

2. What the App stores — and where

The App stores only what the game needs: your garden and its items, Tomesi's outfits and the card designs, the care plant, your petals, your wins and games played, a game in progress, the trial games and gifted games already used, a few play dates (last day opened, last win, last care), your settings (language, sounds, light, reduced motion) and the status of your purchase. This data contains neither your name, nor your email address, nor any personal or device identifier.

  • On your device, in the App's own storage space, and in the device's backups (iCloud or computer) if you make them.
  • In your iCloud, if you are signed in to iCloud on the device, so that you can find your garden on your other devices. This copy is stored by Apple in your iCloud account, under your Apple Account; we have no access to it.

This data is never sent to us or to any third party.

3. Data we collect

None. We operate no server that receives data from the App. We do not collect identifiers, usage statistics, crash reports, advertising data or location data. We do not build profiles, and we do not sell or share any data, since we do not hold any.

4. In-app purchase

The purchase of "The Collection" is handled entirely by Apple (App Store). We receive neither your payment details nor your identity. The App only queries Apple, from your device, to display the price and to know whether the purchase is active. Apple sends us aggregated sales reports, which do not identify you. Payment processing is governed by Apple's privacy policy.

5. Network

The App works offline. It contacts no server of the Publisher. Only the Apple services used by the system may access the network: the App Store for the purchase and its verification, and iCloud for syncing your saved data.

6. Notifications

After a few wins, the App asks you once for permission to show a daily reminder. This reminder is a local notification, scheduled on your device: no remote notification service is used and nothing is sent to us. You can withdraw this permission at any time in iOS Settings. The App requests no other permission.

7. No third-party SDKs, no tracking

The App contains no advertising SDK, no analytics SDK and no tracking technology. The Unity engine's analytics and crash reporting services are disabled. The App does not use the Advertising Identifier (IDFA) and therefore presents no App Tracking Transparency prompt.

If you have agreed to share analytics with app developers in iOS Settings, Apple may send us anonymous, aggregated statistics and crash reports. This sharing is managed by Apple, and you can turn it off in Settings › Privacy & Security › Analytics & Improvements (Share With App Developers).

8. Data retention and deletion

Because all data stays with you, you remain in control:

  • deleting the App erases the data stored on the device;
  • the iCloud copy is not erased when you delete the App: Apple keeps it with your iCloud account, and your garden is restored if you reinstall the App or install it on another device signed in to the same account. To erase it, write to us and we will tell you how;
  • to not use the iCloud copy, sign out of iCloud on the device or, if Tomesi Garden appears in the list of apps using iCloud (Settings › [your name] › iCloud), turn it off there.

We retain nothing, because we receive nothing.

9. Children

The App collects no data, including from children. It contains no advertising, no links to social networks and no chat between players. It is not specifically designed for children.

10. This website

This website contains no advertising, no analytics tool, no form and no cookies. Images, fonts and animations are served with the website; no external font service is loaded. The animation setting is kept in memory only during your visit.

The website is hosted by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., United States). On each visit, GitHub logs the visitor's IP address for security purposes. This data is processed in the United States; for these transfers, GitHub states that it relies on the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework and on standard contractual clauses. See GitHub's privacy statement. The contact link opens your email app: a message is sent only if you choose to send it, and the information it contains is used solely to reply to you.

11. Messages sent to support and your rights (GDPR)

Game data remains under your control, on your device and in your iCloud: we hold none of it. If you write to us or call us, we process your email address or phone number, your name if it appears, and the content of your message, solely to reply to you and handle your request.

  • Data controller: Olivier Saleur (contact details below).
  • Legal basis: our legitimate interest in answering the requests sent to us (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
  • Recipients: the Publisher only; the email service is provided by OVH SAS (France), acting on our behalf.
  • Retention period: three years from our last exchange, then deletion.

You may request access to this data, its rectification, its erasure or the restriction of its processing, and object to this processing, by writing to support@tomesi.com. You may lodge a complaint with your data protection authority; in France, the French Data Protection Authority (CNIL) (www.cnil.fr).

12. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy to reflect changes to the App or to legal requirements. The current version is identified by its date and version number above. Material changes will be published with the App or at the address where this policy is hosted.

13. Contact

Privacy questions: support@tomesi.com · +33 9 72 16 41 97.
